defs.def: the steady and continuous movement of sth/sb in one direction 流；流动

ex.s: Turner wisely said that “doing well” psychologically is being able to roll with the flow of emotions, manage them, communicate clearly and well with others, and master various skills.
ex.t: 当我张开手时，这只鸟没有飞走；它坐着用明亮的眼睛看着我。

ex.s: Many scientists shared the commonsense expectation that as permafrost melted, lakes would at first expand with meltwater flowing into them.
ex.t: 我受邀去华盛顿西部一位老朋友的农场参加烧烤聚会。

ex.s: A dirty stream, for example, often became clear after flowing through plants and along rocks where tiny creatures lived.
ex.t: 例如，一条肮脏的小溪流经植物和居住着微小生物的岩石后常常变清澈。

ex.s: It made the sweetest sound I'd ever heard!My heart was dancing along with its flowing tune.
ex.t: 这些试卷是学生们常用的练习材料，可以让 you 了解老师如何出题以及他们认为什么是相关内容。

ex.s: His job is to sit beside the pianist and turn the pages of the score so the musicians don’t have to break the flow of sound by doing it themselves.
ex.t: 他的工作是坐在钢琴家旁边翻乐谱，这样音乐家就不必自己翻谱而打断音乐的流畅性。

ex.s: Seconds later, our lizard emerged from its tank with its old skin flowing behind it.
ex.t: 几秒钟后我们的蜥蜴从箱子里钻了出来旧皮跟在身后飘动。

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关联的新型计时方式这些状况可能因全球变暖而发生变化．我们正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座钟它反映了几条主要阿拉斯加河流的总流量这些河流对当地和全球的环境变化都很敏感．我们已经编程让它在水流保持当前速率时与原子钟同步．如果将来河流平均流速加快钟会比标准时间走得快．如果河流变慢你会看到相反的效果．

ex.s: Smooth traffic flow on the road.

defs.def: the continuous production or supply of sth 持续生产；不断供应
continuous talk by sb 滔滔不绝
the way that words and ideas are linked together in speech or writing 连贯；流畅
the movement of the sea towards the land 涨潮
to move steadily and continuously in one direction 液体、气体或电

ex.s: Tu says that the balance between the black and white pieces, the beauty in the ____63____ (strategy) placement of the pieces, ____64____ the energy flow following each move inspired artists to create oil paintings, sculptures, ____65____ (digital) generated pictures and silk-screen prints for the exhibition.
ex.t: 哪项最适合作为本文标题？

defs.def: to move or pass continuously from one place or person to another, especially in large numbers or amounts 人或事物

ex.s: People prepare decorations with flowers and dance around maypoles.
ex.t: 人们用鲜花做装饰，围着五朔节花柱跳舞。

ex.s: Today, I gave my aunt some flowers and a scarf.
ex.t: 今天，我给了婶婶一些花和一条围巾。

ex.s: People celebrate the festival by climbing mountains, appreciating chrysanthemum flowers and drinking chrysanthemum wine.
ex.t: 人们通过登山、赏菊花和饮菊花酒来庆祝这个节日。

ex.s: The colours of the flowers range from bright yellows to brownish yellows, showing that the flowers are at different stages of life.
ex.t: 花的颜色从亮黄色到棕黄色不等，显示出花朵处于生命的不同阶段。

defs.def: to develop or be produced in an easy and natural way 流畅

ex.s: Materials for making natural dyes can often be found in gardens 2 _____ colourful flowers are planted.
ex.t: 制作天然染料的材料通常可以在种了五颜六色鲜花的花园里找到。

defs.def: to be available easily and in large amounts 有的是；大量供应
to be felt strongly by sb 强烈感到
to hang loosely and freely 飘垂；飘拂
to come in towards the land 海潮
